messages:
emma: Heads up — I just got an onboarding email supposedly from HR asking me to 'complete your onboarding profile' with a link. It looks off. attaching screenshot. @sec-oncall
sec-bot: New phishing report created: PHISH-2026-003. Message flagged by user. Severity: medium. Sandbox queued.
tom: @emma can you paste the raw headers or the link? don't click it again. we'll sandbox. pls DM if credentials entered.
emma: link = https://redwood-boarding[dot]com/complete?uid=em123 (copied from email). sender = hr-notify@redwoodcorp.com (display name 'HR Team')
sana: thx. initial look — display name spoofs ok. headers show SPF fail, DKIM neutral. IP 198.51.100.23 (us-west) not in our mail providers. I'm picking this up.
tom: started sandbox run. @sandbox-bot run-url https://redwood-boarding.com/complete?uid=em123 — capture network, js, and screenshots.
sandbox-bot: Sandbox report ready: verdict = phishing. Indicators: 1) form exfiltrates to https://tracking.clientapp[.]net/collect 2) JS obfuscated, uses websock to send base64 creds 3) Hosted on ephemeral infra with no cert chain. Full log: /sbox/reports/1769876543
sana: confirmed. IOC list: domains: redwood-boarding.com, tracking.clientapp.net; ip 198.51.100.23; sender ip 203.0.113.12. Add to blocklist and mail filter.
it-helpdesk: Blocking domains in org DNS and updating mail gateway rules now. Also pushing banner to all users about recent fake HR emails. ETA 20m.
maria: Did anyone click link? I think emma did not. She reported after seeing it. double-checking logs.
tom: Checked CloudFront access logs and our SSO audit — no auth attempts from emma. No tokens issued. We should still force MFA refresh for all new hires who received email. Recommend targeted password reset for any who clicked.
sec-oncall: KMS note — no suspicious access to any KMS keys. We queried Cloud KMS access logs for the timeframe; only normal service accounts. I'll attach logs to ticket.
sana: Post-incident tasks: 1) update mail filter with IOCs 2) block domains at DNS 3) send org-wide awareness 4) create internal doc for HR to verify templates 5) run quick audit of recent welcome emails for template leaks.
emma: thanks everyone. can we include a short how-to for new hires? A lot of them might get similar scams.
maria: I'll draft a short FAQ for new hires + a notice to HR to sign emails with an enforced DKIM subdomain. @tom can you help with DKIM signing guidance?
tom: yup. also recommend adding DMARC p=quarantine and strict SPF entries for our HR-sending service.
sec-bot: Incident PHISH-2026-003 updated: status = contained; assigned = tom, sana; follow-ups = awareness-email, mailrules, hr-template.
maria: Thanks. Closing thread after awareness message sent.
